errors: A first test fixture used the word PART, which LABELISH treats as a label, so the continuation stopped. Reworded the fixture.

CI validate went red on test_promptctl's shallow-edge lookup test, which my diff did not touch. Cause: CI's PR merge checkout has two shallow roots (the main head at 17:10-07:00 and the PR head at 00:11+00:00, so the date strings fall on different days). The one-pass index dated root-only paths by the newest root, while `git log -1 -- path` follows first parents to main's root. Fixed in promptctl._last_change_indexes. Reproduced in a depth-2 fetch of refs/pull/19530/merge: red before the fix, green after, and 0 of 200 sampled edge paths mismatch git. While CI ran, main landed an equivalent fix (_first_parent_root, P094). The merge took main's version and dropped this PR's copy.

doc_friction.issue: Item 4 suggests module-weight/module-exclusive on ventures/<slug>/index.html. local-site-studio and quick-pick-survey are Next.js apps with no index.html, so the tool throws ENOENT. The prompt could say it covers only static-page ventures.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
